title: Rule-Based Gloss Restructuring
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of mapping_rules and regular expression transformations, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in sign-language-to-text-translation.
learning_objectives: Explain mapping_rules and regular expression transformations in plain language and connect it to sign_language_translator/languages/sign/mapping_rules.py; sign_language_translator/languages/sign/pakistan_sign_language.py.
Trace one input through the rule-based gloss restructuring stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the rule-based gloss restructuring stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for mapping_rules and regular expression transformations.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
